issues.description: The proposal omits the high-confidence technical pain point that the custom dispatch tool, Routemaster, has severe technical debt that prevents the team from shipping new features.
issues.suggested_fix: Explicitly name Routemaster and mention its severe technical debt and the resulting inability to ship new features in the Technical & Organizational Context section.

issues.description: The proposal fails to acknowledge the high-confidence risk that internal attempts to fix the workflow have failed twice before. Acknowledging this is critical to show empathy and justify the proposed approach.
issues.suggested_fix: Add a note in the Understanding section about the two previous failed internal attempts, and explain in the Approach section how the external, portable workflow layer will succeed where internal efforts did not.

issues.description: The high-confidence strategic pain point regarding fundamental stakeholder misalignment on the core problem to solve is missing from the proposal.
issues.suggested_fix: Acknowledge the fundamental misalignment among stakeholders on the core problem in the Understanding section, and position the Phase 1A Discovery phase as the mechanism to achieve executive consensus.

issues.description: The proposal notes the November ELD deadline but misses the medium-confidence risk that failing to meet it could result in fines or losing operating authority.
issues.suggested_fix: Update the Compliance Requirements bullet to explicitly state the severe business risk of losing operating authority if the ELD deadline is missed.

risks: By omitting key high-confidence pain points (severe technical debt, past failed internal attempts, and fundamental stakeholder misalignment), the proposal risks coming across as generic and failing to demonstrate a deep, nuanced understanding of the client's specific internal struggles.
